protocol_boundary: Fit normalization, feature selection, direction, routing, and thresholds on training/calibration partitions only. The held-out test set is evaluation-only.
relationship_to_book: Adapter/wrapper only; src/iia_benchmark/models/univariate_book.py remains the source-faithful Chapter 2 implementation.

references.citation: Rousseeuw and Croux, Alternatives to the Median Absolute Deviation, JASA 1993
Rosenblatt, Remarks on a Multivariate Transformation, Annals of Mathematical Statistics 1952
Sugiyama et al., Direct importance estimation with model selection and its application to covariate shift adaptation, Annals of the Institute of Statistical Mathematics 2008
Kunsch, The Jackknife and the Bootstrap for General Stationary Observations, Annals of Statistics 1989

validation_evidence: tests/test_adaptive_univariate.py; real-data ablation is registered in configs/experiments/univariate_adaptation_benchmark.json
